title: Agent Identity Registry (sandbox)
description: SECB-WP-FWK-081, issue #145. Describes the identity substrate a set of agent roles operates under, so an AIS level can be COMPUTED from evidence instead of asserted. THIS SCHEMA IS FOR A SANDBOX. No GitHub App, installation, secret, token or permission is created by anything that reads it, and no registry conforming to it can raise the production level: production_ais_level is pinned to NOT_OBSERVED. ROLE_LABEL != PLATFORM_PRINCIPAL != CREDENTIAL_CUSTODY_DOMAIN != DECISION_INDEPENDENCE -- the four are separate fields here because a single field would let one of them stand in for the others.

production_ais_level.description: A fixture can demonstrate the SHAPE of AIS1-AIS3 evidence. It cannot observe production, and it must never advance production to AIS4.

max_computable_level.description: AIS4 requires independent failure domains, which a single simulated environment cannot exhibit.

algorithm.description: Real OIDC tokens are asymmetrically signed and verified against a published JWKS. A shared-secret HMAC proves a fixture was not edited; it proves nothing about an issuer.

principals.description: One entry per role. Keys are role names; a role name is a LABEL and is never evidence.

custody_domain.description: The broker holding this principal's private key. Separate custody means a compromise of one broker does not yield another's token.

policy_domain.description: Who decides what this principal may request. Same broker with one policy is one domain wearing several names.

failure_domain.description: What takes this principal down. Required for AIS4 and NOT computable in a sandbox.

expires_in_seconds.description: An hour ceiling is not least privilege on its own: a token scoped to every repository with broad permissions is over-privileged for the whole hour.

workflow_sha.description: workflow_ref names a path; workflow_sha pins its content. A ref without a sha binds a moveable target.

job_workflow_sha.description: Required whenever job_workflow_ref is present: under a reusable workflow the executing definition is not the entry workflow.

actor_id.description: PROHIBITED as a principal. actor_id is the account that started the workflow, not the agent holding the role.

reuse_after_revoke.description: Only DENIED is evidence. A 204 says a call was accepted, not that the token stopped working.
